new_results.summary: Flatness removed: arbitrary unit exceptional eigenvector v in epsilon*lambda*I_4+(mu-epsilon*lambda)vv^T has density cap C_orient/lambda with C_orient<24.193.
For n>=4, n-1 equal same-sign eigenvalues epsilon*lambda and one arbitrary eigenvalue imply density norm <24.193/lambda for arbitrary orientation.
A 4x4 original-coordinate block with three eigenvalues within lambda/100 of one common signed value and a fourth arbitrary eigenvalue has affine quadratic density cap <26.697/lambda.
